steps.explanation:
Start with two separate integers.
The pointers have not been declared yet.

p points to a and q points to b.
The labels show which variable each points to.
Save the value that p points to in temp.

Copy the value at q into the variable at p.
Both a and b now hold 9.

Write the saved value into the variable at q.
The values swapped. The pointer targets stayed fixed.
